Messages.Author: Dave
Messages.Body:
The master-out-of-turn card Frenzy states: "This round has a press, only
usable to continue combat."

The "has a press" bit suggests that there IS a press, whether you like it or
not kind of thing, but the "usABLE" bit suggests the user has the option to
press or not. Which one????

Ta.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Dave <Ja...@se-inf.demon.co.uk> writes:
>The master-out-of-turn card Frenzy states: "This round has a press, only
>usable to continue combat."

>The "has a press" bit suggests that there IS a press, whether you like it or
>not kind of thing, but the "usABLE" bit suggests the user has the option to
>press or not. Which one????

The former. The "usable" part just means that this press won't cancel
any other standing press (like from a Trap, or from another Frenzy).
